scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mahjong-together/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "npm run dev -w @mahjong-together/shared" "npm run dev -w @mahjong-together/server" "npm run dev -w @mahjong-together/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mahjong-together/shared && npm run build -w @mahjong-together/web && npm run build -w @mahjong-together/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mahjong-together/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e:results: playwright test -c playwright.results.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.results-lifecycle.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:all: playwright test && npm run test:e2e:claims && npm run test:e2e:kongs && npm run test:e2e:results && npm run test:e2e:wins
